verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an OpenAI-compatible base URL, a model catalog, and a 132-path OpenAPI spec, but no item documents a GET /v1/models-style endpoint for listing the live catalog. The claim that OpenAI code "works without changes" is general compatibility marketing, not specific documentation of model enumeration, so it cannot be credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent enumerate the live model catalog programmatically via a documented GET /v1/models-style endpoint
